description: This file is a controller class for managing themes in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting themes, as well as loading theme templates and stylesheets.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class for managing themes in OpenCart's admin panel, providing CRUD operations and auxiliary functions for theme template management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that loads the theme list view with filters and navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Proxy method that calls getList and outputs the theme list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of themes with filtering options, preparing data for the theme list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Loads the form for adding or editing a theme, including loading available stylesheets, templates, and extensions.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Loads a specific template's content via AJAX, supporting both default and extension templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of theme data, supporting both creation and update, with permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected themes by setting their status to active, with permission checks.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected themes by setting their status to inactive, with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected themes from the database, with permission validation.
